learning_outcomes.text: Students have a broad basic knowledge of calculation techniques and procedures regarding elementary mathematical functions and vector calculus.
Students can apply standard mathematical procedures of engineering sciences.
They can describe and solve simple domain-specific problems using mathematical methods.

assessment_rules: The selection of the examination form from the given options is up to the respective lecturer, adhering to the valid study regulations. The composition of the portfolio exam can be found in the respective valid study regulations. Examination duration and scope vary depending on the specific portfolio exam (PFP-1, PFP-2, PFP-3) or standard exam, as detailed in the study regulations.
